title.zh: 般琉卢 · 手动搓招与连携升级
title.en: Banyue / Dialyn / Lucia · Manual combos and Chain upgrades

summary.zh: 本站据作者与固定机制整理：卢西娅开梦境、琉音升级连携，般岳手动用山威收尾。非逐帧原轴。
summary.en: DUKE synthesis of authored methods and fixed mechanics: Lucia establishes Dream, Dialyn upgrades Chains, and Banyue spends Mountain’s Might manually. Not an authored frame timeline.

conditions.zh: 循环站位琉音→卢西娅→般岳；般岳既是卢西娅下一位，也是琉音上一位。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Dialyn → Lucia → Banyue; Banyue is both Lucia’s next slot and Dialyn’s previous slot.

conditions.zh: 引火只在未接战且机会可用时发动；连携／终结技不会凭空给满嗔火。
conditions.en: Inflame requires being out of combat with the opportunity available; Chain/Ultimate does not fill Wrathful Fires from nothing.

conditions.zh: 琉音强制连携不等于敌人已失衡；90好评、客诉及真实窗口必须分别核对。
conditions.en: Dialyn’s forced Chain does not mean the enemy is Stunned; check 90 Positive Reviews, Complaint and the actual prompt separately.

conditions.zh: 基础路线不要求影画或专武；轻为普攻，重为特殊技，按已设置键位操作。
conditions.en: The base route requires no Mindscapes or signature engines. Light means Basic and Heavy means Special, using the configured keys.

conditions.zh: 旧版本作者手法已对照固定3.3基础机制；不沿用旧伤害排名、固定秒轴或潜能觉醒变招。
conditions.en: Older authored methods are checked against fixed 3.3 base mechanics; old rankings, fixed rotations and Awakening variants are excluded.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 般琉卢站位与手动指令（2.4）
label.en: Little Orange · Banyue team order and manual inputs (2.4)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 琉音猜拳与连携升级（2.4）
label.en: Little Orange · Dialyn RPS and Chain upgrades (2.4)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 卢西娅梦境与快支（2.3）
label.en: Little Orange · Lucia Dream and Quick Assist (2.3)

objective.zh: 能战前引火就先做，再补两位辅助。
objective.en: Use pre-combat Inflame when legal, then establish both supports.

title.en: Use Inflame before combat if available

input.zh: 未接战时长按普攻，随后普通切琉音
input.en: Hold Basic out of combat, then switch normally to Dialyn

trigger.zh: 生命大于50%、嗔火不足120，且本次引火机会可用。
trigger.en: HP exceeds 50%, Wrathful Fires are below 120, and the Inflame opportunity remains.

complete.zh: 看实际是否到120并进入怒相；没有成功就按普通循环处理。
complete.en: Check whether it actually reached 120 and entered Wrath; otherwise use the normal loop.

reason.zh: 先使用仅允许战前发动的启动手段，避免辅助先开打后再错误要求引火。
reason.en: Use the pre-combat-only starter before support attacks make it unavailable.

fallback.zh: 已接战或无法引火则跳过，但仍普通切琉音；不把开局怒相预设为已获得。
fallback.en: Skip if in combat or unavailable, but still switch normally to Dialyn; do not prefill Wrath.

signal.zh: 引火完成或跳过后，普通切琉音。
signal.en: After completing or skipping Inflame, switch normally to Dialyn.

title.zh: 琉音石头→剪刀→布，挂恶意投诉
title.en: Dialyn Rock → Scissors → Paper, apply Malicious Complaint

input.zh: 普通切琉音；有资源时连续三次EX，可穿插普攻
input.en: Switch normally to Dialyn; use three EX attacks with sufficient energy, optionally weaving Basics

trigger.zh: 需要补恶意投诉／好评；每次衔接须在形态保留窗口内，且能量实际足够。
trigger.en: Malicious Complaint/Positive Reviews need a refresh; each follow-up must fit its form window and energy must suffice.

complete.zh: 确认布命中挂恶意投诉；好评只按重击实际命中增加，不预设已满90。
complete.en: Confirm Paper hits and applies Malicious Complaint; Positive Reviews accrue from actual heavy hits, not assumed to reach 90.

reason.zh: 先布置失衡增益，再交回卢西娅和般岳；三段能量不能只按一段预算。
reason.en: Prepare the Stun debuff, then return to Lucia and Banyue; budget for all three attacks.

fallback.zh: 已有足够覆盖可省略EX，但人在琉音时仍普通切卢西娅；能量不足按实际招式结束，不伪称打出了布。
fallback.en: Skip EX with sufficient coverage, but still switch from Dialyn to Lucia. With low energy, stop at the real form instead of claiming Paper occurred.

signal.zh: 招式结束后普通切卢西娅。
signal.en: After the attack, switch normally to Lucia.

title.zh: 卢西娅强化特殊技接普攻第五段
title.en: Lucia EX Special into Basic hit five

input.zh: 强化特殊技 → 点按普攻直达第五段
input.en: EX Special → tap Basic for hit five

trigger.zh: 开局或梦境耗尽需要重建；若只是延长帷幕，核对当前梦境与能量。
trigger.en: Opening or Dream has run out; for a Veil extension, check current Dream and energy.

complete.zh: 核对梦境、帷幕和破暗；童谣须真实触发招式升级或追加攻击，不把进梦自动当成全增益。
complete.en: Check Dream, Veil and Darkbreaker; Nursery Rhyme requires a real skill upgrade or Aftershock, not merely entering Dream.

reason.zh: 未进梦时EX回60、普五回40；开局已有60时EX可先进梦，再用普五升级。
reason.en: Outside Dream, EX grants 60 and hit five grants 40; with the initial 60, EX can enter Dream before hit five upgrades.

fallback.zh: 已有覆盖可省略刷新，但卢西娅在前台时仍交给主攻；没有真实快支就普通切人，跳过下一快支事件。
fallback.en: Skip an unnecessary refresh, but still return to the attacker if Lucia is on field. Without a real assist prompt, switch normally and skip the next assist event.

signal.zh: 仅在真实快支提示出现时接下一位主攻；否则普通切人。
signal.en: Take the next-slot attacker only through a real Quick Assist prompt; otherwise switch normally.

input.zh: 按目标角色快支提示入场
input.en: Accept the intended attacker’s Quick Assist prompt

trigger.zh: 卢西娅进梦或终结技命中触发提示，且下一位为当前主攻。
trigger.en: Lucia entering Dream or landing Ultimate has produced a prompt, and the attacker is next in order.

complete.zh: 完成实际快支，重新查看自身资源和辅助状态。
complete.en: Complete the actual assist and recheck personal resources and support states.

reason.zh: 保持卢西娅→主攻的循环站位，使支援直接到输出角色。
reason.en: Keep Lucia immediately before the attacker so the assist reaches the damage dealer.

fallback.zh: 已通过普通换人入场就跳过，不补按并虚算一次快支。
fallback.en: Skip if already on field through a normal switch; do not invent an assist.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

title.zh: 怒相中手动打地动／山摇
title.en: Manually alternate Earth Shaker / Mountain Tremor in Wrath

input.zh: 快速输入轻重轻→重重轻→轻重轻→重重轻，每组确认派生。轻=普攻，重=特殊技。
input.en: Rapidly input Light-Heavy-Light → Heavy-Heavy-Light → Light-Heavy-Light → Heavy-Heavy-Light, confirming each follow-up. Light=Basic, Heavy=Special.

trigger.zh: 已经怒相、有山威且处于快支、焚身、连携、终结技或EX等合法派生窗口。
trigger.en: Already in Wrath with Mountain’s Might and a legal Quick Assist, Immolate, Chain, Ultimate or EX follow-up window.

complete.zh: 确认四次实际EX及山威消耗；手动派生两种不同EX满足摧岳前提，明王按实际手动触发累计。
complete.en: Check four actual EX attacks and Mountain’s Might spent; two different manual EX forms enable the finisher, and Vidyaraja counts actual manual triggers.

reason.zh: 用山威替代闪能并积累明王；合轴只认完美取消后的攻击保留，不当作可以随时切队友。
reason.en: Spend Mountain’s Might instead of Adrenaline and build Vidyaraja; preserved attacks require proper cancellation, not arbitrary teammate switches.

fallback.zh: 没有怒相／山威则用普通资源循环；取消不熟时宁可完整出招，不硬凑四次或固定时长。
fallback.en: Without Wrath/Mountain’s Might, use the normal resource loop. If cancellation is unfamiliar, finish attacks rather than forcing four attacks or fixed timing.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

title.en: Finish with the enhanced finisher into mountain strike

input.zh: 怒相中手动派生过两种不同EX后长按普攻
input.en: After manually performing two different EX forms in Wrath, hold Basic

trigger.zh: 怒相仍在，且已满足两种不同EX条件；山威优先按窗口消耗。
trigger.en: Wrath remains and two different EX forms have been performed; spend Mountain’s Might as the window allows.

complete.zh: 确认摧岳自动衔接倾山，退出怒相；剩余山威会清空。
complete.en: Confirm the enhanced finisher automatically leads into the mountain strike and exits Wrath; remaining Mountain’s Might is cleared.

reason.zh: 把资源收尾留在有效窗口；退出后重新积攒嗔火。
reason.en: Resolve the resource finisher inside the available window, then rebuild Wrathful Fires.

fallback.zh: 不在怒相则跳过；怒相中未满足两种EX只会走普通倾山。失衡将结束时不要为凑满而丢失收尾。
fallback.en: Skip outside Wrath; without two different EX forms, Wrath only permits the normal finisher. Do not lose the finisher by forcing extra attacks as Stun ends.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

prep.zh: 未成功引火时，手动怒相与收尾两步暂不可用，改用常态地动→山摇积攒。
prep.en: If Inflame did not succeed, skip the Wrath/manual-finisher steps and use normal Earth Shaker → Mountain Tremor to build resources.

objective.zh: 常态搓招积攒资源，辅助按需刷新。
objective.en: Build resources with normal combos and refresh supports as needed.

title.zh: 平时用地动→山摇积攒嗔火
title.en: Use Earth Shaker → Mountain Tremor to build Wrathful Fires

input.zh: 普攻三段→特殊技出地动，再快速重重轻；快支后也可长按特殊技起手
input.en: Basic three hits → Special for Earth Shaker, then rapid Heavy-Heavy-Light; after Quick Assist, hold Special to start

trigger.zh: 不处于怒相，闪能可支付实际两招；上一招进入正确派生窗口。
trigger.en: Not in Wrath, Adrenaline can pay the actual two attacks, and the correct follow-up window is open.

complete.zh: 核对实际EX及耗能回嗔火；后续是否为山摇·怒以资源和招式为准。
complete.en: Check actual EX attacks and Wrathful Fires from spending; the Wrath variant depends on real resources and form.

reason.zh: 把常态输出转换成下一次怒相的准备，不把所有连招都视为免费。
reason.en: Turn normal damage into preparation for the next Wrath state without treating every combo as free.

fallback.zh: 资源不足用普攻／合法闪反；敌人来招可不输入方向点闪避格挡，成功后才计嗔火。
fallback.en: With low resources use Basics/legal counters. Against a real attack, Dodge without directional input can block; only a successful block grants resource.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

title.en: Dialyn Rock → Scissors → Paper, apply Malicious Complaint

fallback.en: Skip EX with sufficient coverage, but still switch from Dialyn to Lucia. With low energy, stop at the real form instead of claiming Paper occurred.

signal.en: After the attack, switch normally to Lucia.

title.zh: 卢西娅强化特殊技接普攻第五段
title.en: Lucia EX Special into Basic hit five

input.zh: 强化特殊技 → 点按普攻直达第五段
input.en: EX Special → tap Basic for hit five

trigger.zh: 开局或梦境耗尽需要重建；若只是延长帷幕，核对当前梦境与能量。
trigger.en: Opening or Dream has run out; for a Veil extension, check current Dream and energy.

fallback.en: Skip an unnecessary refresh, but still return to the attacker if Lucia is on field. Without a real assist prompt, switch normally and skip the next assist event.

signal.en: Take the next-slot attacker only through a real Quick Assist prompt; otherwise switch normally.

input.en: Accept the intended attacker’s Quick Assist prompt

trigger.en: Lucia entering Dream or landing Ultimate has produced a prompt, and the attacker is next in order.

complete.en: Complete the actual assist and recheck personal resources and support states.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

prep.zh: 第一段结束且辅助需刷新时普通切琉音；覆盖足够则保持般岳并省略辅助三步。
prep.en: After the first combo, switch normally to Dialyn only when support needs refreshing; otherwise keep Banyue and skip the three support events.

prep.zh: 怒相期间不再积攒嗔火；山威用尽但仍怒相时后续EX会改用闪能。
prep.en: Wrath does not accumulate more Wrathful Fires; EX attacks consume Adrenaline after Mountain’s Might runs out.

objective.zh: 核对真实升级窗口与怒相资源，手动打完再收尾。
objective.en: Check the real upgrade prompt and Wrath resources, then perform manual attacks before finishing.

title.zh: 琉音送客，检查连携升级窗口
title.en: Dialyn Get Lost!; check the upgraded Chain window

input.zh: 普通切琉音，长按普攻发动送客；在升级连携窗口选般岳
input.en: Switch normally to Dialyn and hold Basic for Get Lost!; select Banyue in the upgraded Chain window

trigger.zh: 持有客诉且好评至少90；恶意投诉与卢西娅增益已覆盖。
trigger.en: Complaint is available and Positive Reviews are at least 90; Malicious Complaint and Lucia support cover the window.

complete.zh: 自然打开连携时升级消耗60好评；未打开而强制触发则消耗90。强制窗口不代表失衡。
complete.en: An upgrade from a naturally opened Chain spends 60 Positive Reviews; forcing a window spends 90. A forced window does not imply Stun.

reason.zh: 让般岳获得实际升级终结技入场；送客的上一位快支和升级连携不能混算。
reason.en: Give Banyue an actual upgraded Ultimate entry; do not conflate Get Lost!’s previous-slot assist with the upgraded Chain.

fallback.zh: 没有升级窗口就不执行下一步；仅有快支可接上一位般岳，但按快支／普通循环处理。客诉不足等下一真实机会。
fallback.en: Without an upgrade prompt, skip the next event. A normal Quick Assist can bring previous-slot Banyue in, but uses the assist/normal loop. Without Complaint, wait for a real opportunity.

signal.zh: 在真实升级连携窗口中选择般岳。
signal.en: Select Banyue in the actual upgraded Chain prompt.

title.zh: 般岳接升级终结技入场
title.en: Banyue enters with the upgraded Ultimate

input.zh: 在琉音升级窗口选择般岳，不额外重复按Q
input.en: Select Banyue in Dialyn’s upgraded prompt; do not press Q again for the same event

trigger.zh: 上一事件确实产生升级窗口，且选择目标为般岳。
trigger.en: The previous event actually produced an upgraded prompt with Banyue selected.

complete.zh: 完成终结技并看怒相；固定源要求嗔火大于120才自动入怒相。
complete.en: Complete the Ultimate and check Wrath; the fixed source requires more than 120 Wrathful Fires for automatic entry.

reason.zh: 利用升级窗口启动输出，但不把终结技当作自动补满资源。
reason.en: Use the upgraded entry to start damage without treating Ultimate as a full resource refill.

fallback.zh: 没有升级窗口，跳过本事件；普通连携或本人就绪Q分别按真实提示处理。
fallback.en: Without an upgraded window, skip this event; handle a normal Chain or personally ready Ultimate by its actual prompt.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

title.zh: 核对怒相；正好120时手动焚身
title.en: Check Wrath; manually enter at exactly 120

input.zh: 尚未怒相且有120嗔火时长按普攻
input.en: Hold Basic if not already in Wrath and 120 Wrathful Fires are available

trigger.zh: 终结技／连携后未自动入怒相，或本轮以常规入场开始。
trigger.en: Chain/Ultimate did not automatically enter Wrath, or this window started with a normal entry.

complete.zh: 确认怒相和4点山威；已有怒相直接跳过，不再长按触发提前收尾。
complete.en: Confirm Wrath and four Mountain’s Might; skip if already in Wrath to avoid an early finisher.

reason.zh: 把大于120的自动条件与120的手动条件分开。
reason.en: Separate the automatic greater-than-120 condition from the manual 120 condition.

fallback.zh: 嗔火不足改用常态循环，不把强制连携或入场动作视为四点山威。
fallback.en: With insufficient resource, use the normal loop; a forced Chain or entry is not automatically four Mountain’s Might.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

input.en: Rapidly input Light-Heavy-Light → Heavy-Heavy-Light → Light-Heavy-Light → Heavy-Heavy-Light, confirming each follow-up. Light=Basic, Heavy=Special.

trigger.zh: 已经怒相、有山威且处于快支、焚身、连携、终结技或EX等合法派生窗口。
trigger.en: Already in Wrath with Mountain’s Might and a legal Quick Assist, Immolate, Chain, Ultimate or EX follow-up window.

complete.zh: 确认四次实际EX及山威消耗；手动派生两种不同EX满足摧岳前提，明王按实际手动触发累计。
complete.en: Check four actual EX attacks and Mountain’s Might spent; two different manual EX forms enable the finisher, and Vidyaraja counts actual manual triggers.

reason.zh: 用山威替代闪能并积累明王；合轴只认完美取消后的攻击保留，不当作可以随时切队友。
reason.en: Spend Mountain’s Might instead of Adrenaline and build Vidyaraja; preserved attacks require proper cancellation, not arbitrary teammate switches.

fallback.zh: 没有怒相／山威则用普通资源循环；取消不熟时宁可完整出招，不硬凑四次或固定时长。
fallback.en: Without Wrath/Mountain’s Might, use the normal resource loop. If cancellation is unfamiliar, finish attacks rather than forcing four attacks or fixed timing.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

title.zh: 明王就绪后，可插入本人终结技
title.en: Optionally use a personally ready Ultimate after building Vidyaraja

input.zh: 本人终结技仍实际可用时按Q
input.en: Press Ultimate only if Banyue’s own Ultimate is actually available

trigger.zh: 已经手动叠明王，且终结技真实就绪、窗口足够容纳后续收尾。
trigger.en: Vidyaraja has been built manually, the Ultimate is truly ready, and the window still allows the finisher.

complete.zh: 以真实就绪状态决定是否完成；不把刚才升级入场与本次按Q重复计数。
complete.en: Use actual readiness; do not count the upgraded entry and this Q as the same activation twice.

reason.zh: 作者怒相手法可在收尾前用就绪终结技，本方案不保证每轮都能插入。
reason.en: The authored Wrath sequence allows a ready Ultimate before the finisher; this is not guaranteed every cycle.

fallback.zh: 未就绪或窗口不足立即跳过，长按普攻收尾。
fallback.en: If unavailable or the window is short, skip directly to the finisher.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

title.en: Finish with the enhanced finisher into mountain strike

input.zh: 怒相中手动派生过两种不同EX后长按普攻
input.en: After manually performing two different EX forms in Wrath, hold Basic

trigger.zh: 怒相仍在，且已满足两种不同EX条件；山威优先按窗口消耗。
trigger.en: Wrath remains and two different EX forms have been performed; spend Mountain’s Might as the window allows.

complete.zh: 确认摧岳自动衔接倾山，退出怒相；剩余山威会清空。
complete.en: Confirm the enhanced finisher automatically leads into the mountain strike and exits Wrath; remaining Mountain’s Might is cleared.

reason.zh: 把资源收尾留在有效窗口；退出后重新积攒嗔火。
reason.en: Resolve the resource finisher inside the available window, then rebuild Wrathful Fires.

fallback.zh: 不在怒相则跳过；怒相中未满足两种EX只会走普通倾山。失衡将结束时不要为凑满而丢失收尾。
fallback.en: Skip outside Wrath; without two different EX forms, Wrath only permits the normal finisher. Do not lose the finisher by forcing extra attacks as Stun ends.

label.zh: 梦境追加攻击 · 须有梦境值、处于帷幕内且命中／冷却满足
label.en: Dream Aftershock · requires Dream Points, active Veil, a qualifying hit and cooldown

prep.zh: 追求失衡爆发时先确认敌人实际失衡；强制窗口可作启动方案，但不能计失衡易伤。
prep.en: For a Stun burst, first confirm actual Stun. A forced window may start damage but does not grant the Stun multiplier.

text.zh: 般岳1影摧岳命中失衡敌人才延长失衡，且同类延长不可叠加；不与琉音恶意投诉简单相加。
text.en: Banyue M1 extends Stun only when the enhanced finisher hits a Stunned enemy, and same-type extensions do not stack; do not simply add it to Dialyn’s Malicious Complaint.

text.zh: 2影消耗山威发动EX才额外回闪能，不增加山威数量，也不在怒相中补嗔火。
text.en: M2 grants extra Adrenaline when an EX spends Mountain’s Might; it adds neither Mountain’s Might nor Wrathful Fires during Wrath.

text.zh: 6影放宽明王获取，但摧岳仍需怒相中手动派生两种不同EX；不删除收尾前提。
text.en: M6 broadens Vidyaraja generation, but the enhanced finisher still requires two different manual EX forms in Wrath.

text.zh: 琉音1影加快好评积累，仍须核对90门槛与客诉；不按固定三段EX保证升级。
text.en: Dialyn M1 speeds up Positive Reviews but still requires the 90 threshold and Complaint; three EX attacks do not guarantee an upgrade.

text.zh: 卢西娅2影的额外贯穿增益需要破暗与涌泉帷幕同时有效。
text.en: Lucia M2’s extra Sheer bonus requires both Darkbreaker and Wellspring Veil.

text.zh: 琉音专武叠层要EX实际造成物理伤害；后台回能不会自动补足好评或客诉。
text.en: Dialyn’s signature stacks require physical EX damage; off-field energy regeneration does not itself fill Positive Reviews or Complaint.

text.zh: 般岳专武随EX发动叠层；无专武仍保留同样的手动派生条件。
text.en: Banyue’s signature stacks on EX activation; the manual follow-up conditions remain the same without it.

text.zh: 卢西娅专武需要本人开帷幕或延长帷幕触发；看真实能量和覆盖决定刷新。
text.en: Lucia’s signature requires her own Veil activation/extension; refresh based on real energy and coverage.

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.强化特殊技 → 点按普攻直达第五段: 按强化特殊技，再点一下普攻，直接衔接第五段。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按目标角色快支提示入场: 出现指向主攻的快速支援提示时，按对应支援键入场。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切琉音；有资源时连续三次EX，可穿插普攻: 琉音在场、每次能量都足够时，依次按三次强化特殊技打出石头、剪刀、布；可穿插普攻，但要在替换窗口内接下一拳。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.快速输入轻重轻→重重轻→轻重轻→重重轻，每组确认派生。轻=普攻，重=特殊技。: 怒相、有山威且已进入派生窗口时快速输入四组：①普攻→特殊技→普攻；②特殊技→特殊技→普攻；③重复①；④重复②。每组都确认已经打出，再接下一组。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.怒相中手动派生过两种不同EX后长按普攻: 怒相中手动打出两种不同的强化特殊技后，长按普攻收尾。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普攻三段→特殊技出地动，再快速重重轻；快支后也可长按特殊技起手: 普攻三段后按特殊技打出地动，再迅速按「特殊技、特殊技、普攻」接山摇；快支后也可长按特殊技起手。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切琉音，长按普攻发动送客；在升级连携窗口选般岳: 琉音在场时长按普攻发动「送客」；出现升级连携选项才选般岳。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.在琉音升级窗口选择般岳，不额外重复按Q: 在琉音的升级连携选人窗口选择般岳；这次入场不用另按终结技键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.本人终结技仍实际可用时按Q: 般岳自己的终结技仍然可用时，按终结技。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1471: 先看嗔火与怒相。尚未怒相、达到120嗔火时可长按普攻；未达标先打普攻与合法特殊技衔接。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.145100003: 能量足够时点按强化特殊技，等斩击命中

145100003: 先放强化特殊技，再点普攻直接接第五段；前面不用打四下，后面也不用连点五下。
Use EX first, then tap Basic to link directly to hit 5. Do not add four or five preliminary taps.
147100003: 条件满足时长按普攻进入怒相，不用先点到某一段。
Hold Basic to enter the stance when its conditions hold; no numbered Basic opener.
147100004: 开局条件满足才长按普攻引火；没有固定普攻连段前置。
Hold Basic only if the opening Ignition conditions are met; no preceding Basic string.
147100006: 怒相中手动打过两种不同的强化特殊技后，长按普攻收尾；先后顺序不能倒过来。
Manually use two distinct EX moves in the stance first, then hold Basic for the finisher.
148100003: 持有客诉时长按普攻就是「送客」；不要求先点普攻，也不是按强化特殊技键。
With a Customer Complaint, hold Basic to use the send-off; no preliminary Basic taps or separate EX press.

1471: 未怒相且嗔火120时可长按普攻；缺资源才用合法的普攻／特殊技路线补，不固定先按几下。
Outside the stance, hold Basic at 120 when taking that entry. If short, recover with a legal Basic/Special route; no preset tap count.
